name: jump-leap
prompt: Quick airy whoosh of a runner leaping upward, soft cloth rustle and a short rising breath of wind, no music, clean one-shot.

name: turn-swat
prompt: Short swishing whoosh of a body pivoting sharply, like a quick footstep scuff on stone with a light fabric swat, dry and snappy.

name: slide-rush
prompt: Low friction rush of boots sliding across gritty stone and leaves, a sustained scraping swoosh that tapers off, no music.

name: relic-pickup
prompt: Bright metallic clink of a small ancient coin or relic fragment being snatched up, with a tiny crystalline shimmer, short and clean.

name: set-bonus-chime
prompt: Three small bronze temple bells struck in quick rising order, resonant warm chimes with a gentle stone-room echo, ceremonial and rewarding.

name: fork-branch
prompt: Creak and snap of a wooden branch bending then springing back, leaves rustling as a path splits, dry wooden thunk at the end.

name: vine-crash
prompt: Heavy thud of a runner slamming into a thick vine barrier, woody impact, snapping twigs and a burst of rustling leaves, dull and weighty.

name: fall-whistle
prompt: Descending airy whistle of something plummeting into a deep gap, fading wind rush downward into silence, no voice, no music.

name: finish-fanfare
prompt: Triumphant short fanfare of a small horn and hand drum at an ancient temple gate, bright rising call with a warm wooden percussion hit, ceremonial.

name: ui-click
prompt: Very short soft tap of a fingertip on a polished wooden button, gentle muted click, minimal and dry.

name: ui-invalid
prompt: Dull muted knock on hollow wood followed by a tiny rattle, a short negative rejection thud, dry and flat.

name: count-tick
prompt: Single crisp tick of a small stone struck against bamboo, short percussive countdown blip, dry and precise.

name: run-go
prompt: Sharp bright strike of a temple wood block with a quick whoosh of air, an energetic starting signal, short and punchy.
